newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baloise says 1996 group net up 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Baloise says 1996 group net up 19 pct.

text.p: * Baloise confirmed it would pay back capital of 80 Swiss francs per share instead of a dividend on 1996 results.

NOTE - Full name of Swiss life and non-life insurer is Baloise Insurance Group. Baloise said in a statement profit growth came from non-life business. Earnings from capital investments in the non-life sector alone rose by 106 million francs. Earnings in the life sector were also good, thanks to gratifying results in the investment field, Baloise wrote.

Baloise first said in December it would pay back capital of 80 Swiss francs per registered share in 1997 rather than a dividend, which it first announced last December. Last year's dividend was 47 Swiss francs. Following the payout, Baloise plans to split its shares at a ratio of two to one.
